What size headlight Bulb fits the 2020-2026 chevy silverado 2500 3500 HD?

Lasfit Official

|

September 11, 2025

Welcome to your ultimate guide for upgrading the headlight bulbs on your 2020-2026 Chevy Silverado 2500 or 3500 HD models. This guide is specifically tailored to help you identify the correct bulb sizes for your Chevy Silverado 2500’s headlights, ensuring a perfect fit and improved lighting performance. Whether you're looking for best LED headlights for Chevy 2500 HD or planning to replace the bulbs for your Chevy 2500 HD, we've got you covered.

Before you begin your bulb replacement, it's essential to note that this guide is accurate for 2020-2026 models of the Chevy Silverado 2500/3500 HD. If your vehicle already comes equipped with LED headlights from the factory, this guide won’t apply, as the bulbs cannot be modified or changed.

We’ve put in the effort to compile all the relevant bulb sizes for your 2020-2026 Chevy Silverado 2500 headlights, so you don’t have to guess. However, it’s always important to verify the specific details of your vehicle, as bulb sizes can sometimes vary by model and production date. That’s why we encourage you to double-check your exact headlight requirements before making your purchase.

2020-2026 Chevy Silverado 2500/3500 HD Headlight Bulb Size Fitment

Here’s a breakdown of the headlight bulb sizes for the 2020-2026 Chevy Silverado 2500 and 3500 HD:


Year
 Model
 Low Beam Headlight Bulb
 High Beam Headlight Bulb
2020 Silverado 2500/3500 HD H11 bulb H11 bulb
2021 Silverado 2500/3500 HD H11 bulb H11 bulb
2022 Silverado 2500/3500 HD H11 bulb H11 bulb
2023 Silverado 2500/3500 HD H11 bulb H11 bulb
2024 Silverado 2500/3500 HD H11 bulb H11 bulb
2025 Silverado 2500/3500 HD H11 bulb H11 bulb

Why Upgrade to LED Headlight Bulbs?

Upgrading to Lasfit Pro-DC series custom-fit LED headlights for your 2020-2025 Chevy Silverado 2500 HD offers a variety of benefits:

● Brighter Illumination (50W, 5000LM per bulb)

The Pro-DC LED bulbs deliver 600% more brightness than halogen bulbs, ensuring better visibility and safety at night or in low-visibility conditions.

● Custom Fit for Easy Installation

Designed specifically for the 2020-2025 Chevy Silverado 2500/3500 HD, these custom-fit LED headlights are engineered for a seamless installation with no modifications required. The H11 bulbs fit perfectly into your vehicle’s OEM housing.

● Built-In OEM-Style Extended Dust Cover

The extended dust cover offers excellent protection against water, dust, and debris, ensuring that your bulbs stay safe and functional in any driving condition.

● Longer Lifespan and Durability

With a dual-cooling system and copper substrates, these LED bulbs prevent overheating and provide a longer lifespan, outperforming traditional halogen bulbs.

● Energy Efficient and Fast Response

LEDs use less power, reducing strain on your vehicle’s electrical system, while the bulbs illuminate instantly, offering faster response times for turn signals and brake lights.
